hands.view: dorsal/radial oblique contact with a sphere

thumb.trace: The near radial thumb descends from the right side of the hand, bends leftward and ends in a broad nail pad against the sphere lower-right side.

index.trace: The closest long-finger ray runs from the dorsal distal hand through two bends to the nail-bearing fingertip on the sphere upper-left surface, next to the thumb web.

middle.trace: The next outer long-finger ray has its own dorsal knuckle and curved chain, ending in the raised nail-bearing pad farther left of the sphere.

ring.trace: A narrow nail-bearing sliver appears between the two near rays, but its base and intervening joints are hidden; it cannot be assigned a full independent ring-finger trace.

little.trace: A rear bent stem descends to the sphere top behind the nearer fingers, but its terminal pad is concealed by the sphere and no separate complete little-finger chain can be identified.

hands.count_observation: The thumb, index and middle are complete visible rays. The rear stem and narrow nail sliver do not prove two remaining independent finger chains, even though a five-finger hand would be expected.
hands.length_observation: The thumb and two near long fingers have plausible bent segment lengths around the medium sphere, and their relative projected positions follow their flexion rather than a simple straight tip-distance comparison. The remaining two rays are interrupted by the sphere/finger overlap; their full centerlines, segment lengths and the shorter little-finger relationship are unknown.
hands.joint_observation: The near visible rays are continuously attached and bend plausibly around the sphere. Rear ulnar joint topology remains hidden and cannot pass. The dorsal/radial origin identifies a right hand; all visible fingertip boundaries, wrist and a short forearm fit.

sequence.observation: One actual panel and one hand were inspected. No temporal sequence is supplied, so there is no observed inter-panel side swap or length change; this does not certify an unshown movement. Within-frame uncertainties, if present, are recorded in the hand checks.

limitations: Actual full-resolution image and enlarged digit/contact details inspected. Qualitative visual anatomy only: hidden bones, exact finger lengths and physical feasibility are not measured. Action fidelity is assessed separately against the catalog props and the visible key pose; a static pose does not validate full motion, contact timing or task success.

action_fidelity.observation: 目录目标为预成形开度适配，道具允许球或圆柱。原图有小、中、大三个球，手只在中球上形成已经接触的抓取姿态，道具及当前开度与中球相符；但没有接触前张开过程，也没有在不同尺寸目标上的手部开度对比，无法确认关键的预成形/尺寸适配行为。因此不把尺寸不同的三个球本身当作已完成开度适配的证据。
